Our sympathies are extended to Olive and we all sincerely trust that Les is well and hope for a speedy return. Dan and Alec Patience. Last heard of in Stalag XIA (between Magdeburg and Berlin.
Alec and Dan Patience are now out of the Army and will be turning up on the Common. Frank Halls reports progress with his leg, Arthur Beales' chief trouble is indigestion.
